phase_prompt.label: The Solar Administrator
phase_prompt.summary: Helämmemelek stands amidst the shimmering heat of the second quarter, monitoring the system's thermal load with stoic exhaustion.
phase_prompt.prompt_block: A photorealistic close-up of Helämmemelek, a figure in heavy black cooling-suit armor, standing in a desert-like simulation environment under a blinding white sun. Heat waves distort the horizon. He holds a translucent tablet displaying amber Ge'ez data streams. His visor reflects the stark geometry of the artificial sky. The mood is oppressive and silent. High dynamic range, cinematic lighting, distinct textures of scorched fabric and glass.
